sources.title: Adilbai/ppo-SnowballTarget · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent trained to play the SnowballTarget environment from Unity ML-Agents. The agent, named Julien the Bear 🐻, learns to accurately throw snowballs at spawning targets to maximize rewards.

sources.snippet: Snowball Target ⛄ SnowballTarget is an environment we created at Hugging Face using assets from Kay Lousberg where you train an agent called Julien the bear 🐻 that learns to hit targets with snowballs. You can learn to train this agent using Deep Reinforcement Learning 👉 with this tutorial.
